item.title: 15th Grow Hawaiian Festival is Feb. 28
item.description: Now in its 15th year, the Grow Hawaiian Festival at Amy B. H. Greenwell Garden in Captain Cook will be celebrating native Hawaiian plant elders this year on Saturday, Feb. 28, starting at 9 a.m.

item.title: HUD revives first-termtrump proposal to eject immigrants in the US Illegally from public housing
item.description: WASHINGTON — The Trump administration announced Thursday that it was reviving a proposal to prevent immigrants without legal status from receiving federal housing assistance, a policy that could displace tens of thousands of legal residents and citizens, many of them children, who live with unauthorized relatives in public housing.

item.title: How energy costs, grocery prices and other everyday expenses have changed one year into the second Trump administration
item.description: It’s been just over a year since President Donald Trump returned to the White House. In that time, he’s moved at a breakneck pace to enact his campaign promises, rolling back environmental regulations and protections, overturning national vaccine guidance and health policy, executing full-forced immigration raids in cities like Minneapolis and Chicago, and, more recently, undertaking a bid to control Greenland, a semiautonomous region of Denmark, a NATO ally.

item.title: Investigators blame NASA and Boeing for Starliner failures
item.description: An investigation into the troubled flight of Boeing’s Starliner spacecraft to the International Space Station in 2024 has uncovered a series of technical and management errors by NASA and the aerospace company.

item.title: US and Iran slide towards conflict as military buildup eclipses talks
item.description: DUBAI — Iran and the United States are sliding rapidly towards military conflict as hopes fade for a diplomatic solution to their standoff over Tehran’s nuclear programme, officials on both sides and diplomats across the Gulf and Europe say.

item.title: NASA conducts successful launchpad test of the massive Artemis rocket
item.description: Practice makes … better, although not perfect.

item.title: What happens to all these trade deals now?
item.description: The Supreme Court’s decision to invalidate many of President Donald Trump’s tariffs threw into doubt a series of trade deals that the administration struck in recent months, including with some of the country’s largest trading partners.

item.title: Epstein scandal leaves some young Trump voters feeling betrayed
After stunning setback, Trump finds other ways to impose tariffs
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump moved swiftly on Friday to resurrect his punishing tariffs and circumvent a stunning loss at the Supreme Court, ordering a new 10% tax on all imports along with other trade actions in a bid to preserve his primary source of economic leverage around the world.

item.title: Look, Ma! Or maybe don’t. Parents of some Olympians face extreme fear.
item.description: LIVIGNO, Italy — Peering up at the Italian Alps, their daughter seconds away from rocketing down a snowy hill and flipping in midair, Christine and Mark Henderson clutched their St. Christopher medals, talismans of safety for adventurers.
